item.title: Engineering Governance in the AI Era
item.description: As AI-assisted engineering accelerates software development, engineering governance becomes more essential than ever. A weak engineering practices and gaps in governance are exposed faster, with potentially greater consequences. Engineering leaders responsible for multiple teams may get plenty of information via dashboards, delivery reports, risk registers, and status meetings. Yet a fundamental question remains: Do we have confidence in the health of our engineering organisation, or are we simply confident in the status reports we receive?
